summary: Fase 5 retest after iteration_16 fixes. Two headline requests validated: (1) /room-scan now uses the whisper 'ESCANEO' eyebrow + big font-medium h1 'Escaneo de Sala' with data-testid='page-header-title' — computed font-weight=500, size=38.4px, letter-spacing=-1.152px (=-0.03em). PASS. (2) All 12 shared components explicitly listed for bulk cleanup (share-dsp-modal, error-boundary, onboarding, ar-room-scan, sync-indicator, spl-meter, guided-tour, share-scene-modal, optimizer-modal, test-signals-player, empty-state, rt60-modal) now contain zero font-black / font-display / tracking-wider occurrences. PASS. Full regression across 11 routes (/scenes /room-scan /gear-builder /dsp /stage-map /channels /live /pa /export-page /toolkit /templates): every route renders the whisper eyebrow + big-title header with data-testid='page-header-title' (or 'premium-title' on /scenes) at font-weight 500, size 38.4-44.8px, letter-spacing -0.03em, and no page-level JS errors. SPL meter on /live and EmptyRoomState on /pa also contain zero legacy class violations. The 'grep sanity litmus test' is a PARTIAL FAIL only because three OTHER files that were NOT in the bulk cleanup list still contain legacy classes: nav.tsx (AppHeader h1 L328, SoundMapLogo wordmark L377, sidebar labels L116/L225 — used by Home shell), ui.tsx (AudioMetricCard L121, StatChip sublabel L311), and scenes/index.tsx (2 status pills L88, L94 — 'tracking-wider' on font-medium uppercase pills). None of these are visible on the affected content pages' new headers (verified by page-level DOM scan on /pa returning totalViolations=0).

issues: nav.tsx L328 (AppHeader h1) still uses 'text-xl font-black text-foreground tracking-tight ... font-display'. AppHeader is the header rendered on Index.tsx (Home), not on subpages — visually the Home wordmark is deliberate. Flag only if the litmus test is meant to apply to Home as well.
nav.tsx L377 (SoundMapLogo wordmark) uses 'text-[15px] font-black ... font-display'. Brand mark — likely intentional identity element.
nav.tsx L116 'Todos los Módulos' sidebar section header uses font-black tracking-widest — visible in the fixed left rail.
nav.tsx L225 (module label pill in nav) uses font-black tracking-wide font-display.
ui.tsx L121 AudioMetricCard value uses text-xl font-black — renders on cards that appear in Home dashboards.
ui.tsx L311 sublabel span uses tracking-wider (a raw class — the spec calls for tracking-[0.28em] instead).
pages/scenes/index.tsx L88 & L94 status pills use 'font-medium uppercase tracking-wider' — should switch to tracking-[0.28em] to be strict about the litmus test.

empty-state.tsx: legacy chrome flagged in iteration_16 for the CTA buttons (rounded-xl bg-primary text-sm font-bold at L59/66) remains — buttons are NOT the requested 'rounded-full bg-white text-[#09090b] pill' style, they are still the older rounded-xl solid pills. Cosmetic — no font-black/font-display/tracking-wider anymore, so it satisfies THIS iteration's grep, but the visual polish gap called out in iteration_16 still stands.

critical_code_review_comments: src/components/soundmap/nav.tsx has TWO header components: AppHeader (L321-340) with the legacy 'text-xl font-black … font-display' h1 kept for Home, and PageHeader (L349-366) with the new whisper+big-title. The two-component split is intentional — the review request only targets PageHeader — but the file could be split into home-header.tsx + page-header.tsx to make the boundary clearer and prevent future sed passes from accidentally touching the Home wordmark.

src/pages/room-scan/index.tsx L466-493 does NOT use <PageHeader/> — it inlines an equivalent whisper+big-title JSX (correctly, with the same classes and data-testid). Functionally identical and passes; a future refactor could replace lines 469-493 with <PageHeader title='Escaneo' subtitle={t('room_scan.title')} right={<stepCounter/>} /> and drop the duplicated block. Only concern: any future edit to the PageHeader whisper spec will need to be replicated here (drift risk).

src/components/soundmap/empty-state.tsx L59/66: the Escanear Sala / Armar Equipo CTAs are still the legacy 'rounded-xl bg-primary text-sm font-bold text-primary-foreground shadow-…' primary buttons. The rest of the app (e.g. /scenes 'Cargar' CTA, /pa demo hero) has moved to rounded-full bg-white text-[#09090b] pills or accent-tinted pills. Convergence would be a small polish PR.

src/pages/scenes/index.tsx L88, L94 use raw 'tracking-wider' on status pills — trivial to migrate to tracking-[0.28em] for consistency with the whisper spec, but visually the difference is 2-3 pixels of letter spacing and the pills still read correctly.

src/components/soundmap/ui.tsx L121 AudioMetricCard 'text-xl font-black' — if AudioMetricCard is used anywhere inside the 11 affected pages (I did not audit its call sites in this iteration), it would visually clash with the quiet aesthetic. Grep across src/pages to confirm usage before deciding whether to soften to font-medium.
